I hear you. When you’ve had so-so experiences before, it makes total sense to be extra careful.

Quality is our whole focus: we grow our roses on their own roots at our Oregon nurseries, ship them in 1-gallon containers with soil (not bare root), defoliate before shipping so they travel well, and everything is true-to-name and virus-free. Our perennials and bulbs are held to the same high standard, and we back our plants with a guarantee.
